how_to_use: Generate IMG-01 first. Regenerate until it is right, then keep that chat open.
For every other image, stay in the same chat and attach the approved IMG-01 as a style reference (IMG-07 also uses it as the composition reference).
Paste each `prompt` exactly as written. ChatGPT has no negative-prompt field, so the avoid-list is already inside every prompt.
ChatGPT exports landscape images at 1536x1024 (3:2). For the 16:9 plates, crop to 16:9 by trimming equally from the top and bottom; every prompt keeps the subject clear of those edges.
Save each file with its exact `file` name in launch-video/public/img/. Vectorise the line art to SVG (vtracer or potrace) when you can; PNG also works.
house_style: Minimal editorial line illustration. One uniform line, about 2px weight at 1080p, in deep burgundy #280417, on a warm cream #F7F1E8 background. Flat colour fills use only the colours listed in this prompt: one or two dominant colours and one accent, nothing else. Generous negative space, calm and quiet mood, simple geometric forms, flat 2D, no shading, no gradients, no texture. People drawn as simple silhouettes with no facial features.
avoid: 3D, photorealistic, gradients, drop shadows, glossy, neon, pure black lines, grey, any colour not listed in the prompt, more than three colours, clutter, sketchy hatching, multiple line weights, watercolour, text, letters, numbers, logos, brand names, app screenshots, detailed faces, extra limbs, busy background.

Create a 16:9 widescreen image. Minimal editorial line illustration. One uniform line, about 2px weight at 1080p, in deep burgundy #280417, on a warm cream #F7F1E8 background. Generous negative space, calm and quiet mood, simple geometric forms, flat 2D, no shading, no gradients, no texture. People drawn as simple silhouettes with no facial features.

Subject: a small-business owner sitting at a small wooden desk in the early morning, three-quarter side view, upright and focused. On the desk: a closed laptop, a coffee mug and a small potted plant. A simple window behind suggests morning light with two or three lines. The figure and desk sit in the right 55% of the frame; the left 45% is completely empty cream. Keep everything away from the top and bottom 10% of the frame.

Colours, use only these: linework deep burgundy #280417, dominant fill soft sand #E8D8C5, accent muted apricot #E8B88A used only for the morning light. Background warm cream #F7F1E8.

Avoid: 3D, photorealistic, gradients, drop shadows, glossy, neon, pure black lines, grey, any colour not listed, more than three colours, clutter, sketchy hatching, multiple line weights, watercolour, text, letters, numbers, logos, brand names, app screenshots, detailed faces, extra limbs, busy background.
